name: Level 4: Lava Tunnel Exploration
objective: Navigate the lava tunnel, find the rock sample and camera, and escape before time runs out.
briefing: Not all lava tunnels are safe. Turn on Laika's flashlight to navigate dark areas and identify a safe path.
Inside the tunnel, find the rock sample button and the camera button. If Laika falls, restart from the cave entrance checkpoint.
The final two minutes are a short victory sequence showing Laika returning to Earth inside the spacecraft.

phases.objective: Follow Laika into the lava tunnel entrance.
Turn on Laika's flashlight to see the dark tunnel path.
Navigate the tunnel using the flashlight. Find the rock sample and camera buttons. Watch for falling rocks!
Interact with the rock sample and camera buttons. Both must be activated to escape.
Both objectives complete. Laika exits the tunnel toward the final destination.
Level 4 complete. Return to the briefing screen.
